categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon materials. Its main product lines include semiconductor silicon polished wafers (6-8 inch), silicon materials for etching equipment (11-21 inch), semiconductor zone-melted silicon single crystals, and semiconductor clean pipe valves. These products serve integrated circuits, discrete devices, power devices, sensors, optical devices, and etching equipment components, widely applied in automotive electronics, industrial electronics, aerospace, and other fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crystal growth technologies such as Czochralski (CZ) method for single crystal silicon growth and zone melting for high-purity silicon. Core technologies include thermal field simulation and design, doping and defect control, large-diameter crystal growth, silicon wafer heat treatment and thin film growth, precision wafer processing and cleaning, and oxygen control in single crystal growth. The company also emphasizes digital manufacturing execution systems (MES), statistical process control (SPC), and has developed proprietary patents and standards in semiconductor silicon material production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor chip manufacturers and etching equipment component producers. The end markets include integrated circuit fabrication, discrete semiconductor devices, power devices, sensors, and related high-tech electronics sectors such as automotive electronics, industrial electronics, and aerospace. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales in China and exports to other countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Beijing and Shandong Province. It also has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Beijing, Shanghai, and Dezhou. The company exports products internationally, though export markets have been affected by geopolitical factors. The company is expanding capacity and technology to serve global semiconductor markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the production of semiconductor-grade silicon materials and components used in chip manufacturing and etching equipment. It supplies critical raw and intermediate materials to downstream semiconductor device manufacturers and equipment producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on integrated circuit industry materials, enhancing silicon material technology and competitiveness, and expanding product lines and services along the semiconductor value chain. The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, with significant R&D investment in new product and technology development, including 8-inch and 12-inch silicon wafers, etching equipment silicon materials, and clean valve components. It also pursues domestic substitution of key raw materials and equipment to reduce costs and improve supply chain security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor silicon wafers, etching equipment silicon materials, and clean valve components. The company mainly uses direct sales to downstream chip manufacturers and equipment producers, supplemented by limited agency and distribution sales. Pricing is market-driven with adjustments based on supply-demand dynamics and customer customization requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic semiconductor silicon material manufacturer in China, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise with multiple national innovation platforms. It competes with global leaders such as Shin-Etsu, SUMCO, and GlobalWafers, focusing on catching up in advanced process products and expanding market share. The company holds a strong position in 6-inch and 8-inch silicon wafers and etching equipment materials, with ongoing efforts to improve technology and product quality to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 995.9 million, a 3.7% increase from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 232.9 million, a slight decline of 8.37%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of RMB 5.37 billion and net assets of RMB 4.34 billion. It continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with a stable growth trajectory focused on high-quality development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological leadership, product quality stability, and rapid market responsiveness. It offers high-purity, low-defect semiconductor silicon materials with advanced processing capabilities tailored to customer specifications. The company also focuses on domestic substitution of key materials and equipment to reduce costs and enhance supply chain security, providing customers with reliable, high-performance silicon materials critical for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
